back_in_stock_enabled.title: Back-in-stock alerts
back_in_stock_enabled.description: Shoppers can ask to be told when a sold-out item or variant is available again.

price_drop_min_percent.title: Minimum price drop (percent)
price_drop_min_percent.description: A price alert fires only when the price fell at least this much below the price at subscription (0 = any drop). Shoppers may ask for a larger drop.

price_drop_min_amount.title: Minimum price drop (minor units)
price_drop_min_amount.description: Absolute minimum drop in the item's currency minor units (0 = any drop).

price_drop_allow_target.title: Shoppers may set a target price

price_drop_requires_stock.title: Only alert price drops while in stock

availability_enabled.title: Availability / slot waitlists
availability_enabled.description: Waitlists for capacity (appointment slots, event seats, limited drops): only as many waiters as there are free units are told, in waitlist order.

availability_notify_per_unit.title: Waiters notified per free unit
availability_notify_per_unit.description: Over-notify to fill capacity faster (e.g. 2 = two waiters per free seat).

custom_types.title: Custom alert types
custom_types.description: Merchant-defined alerts fired by a custom.* event, optionally with a rules@1 condition (context: event, item).

x-ui.help: Example: event custom.preorder_opened, target field itemId, condition event.data.region == 'EU'

target_field.title: Target field in the event data
target_field.description: Path of the item id in event.data (empty = the alert has no target: every subscriber of the type is told).

allow_customer_actor.title: Accept events sent from browsers
allow_customer_actor.description: Off: only events from the merchant's servers (sk_ keys) fire this type.

capacity_field.title: Capacity field
capacity_field.description: With notify = capacity: path of the number of free units in event.data.

pending_max_days.title: Subscriptions expire after (days)
pending_max_days.description: A subscription that never fired is removed after this many days.

repeat.title: Keep subscriptions after an alert
repeat.description: On: the subscription is re-armed after each alert (until it expires or the shopper unsubscribes). Off: one alert per subscription.
